entries.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
entries.purpose: Deploys each Worker through deploy-worker.yml from its repository production environment.

entries.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.purpose: Names the account that deploy-worker.yml deploys into.

entries.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
entries.purpose: Signs GitHub App tokens for the demo git-demo.yml pull requests.

entries.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
entries.purpose: Identifies the GitHub App for git-demo.yml.

entries.name: WG_OPS_TOKEN
entries.purpose: Opens the wg-edge /admin/* operator gate.

entries.name: WG_SESSION_KEY
entries.purpose: Root key that wg-edge derives every per-purpose app key from.

entries.name: demo-session
entries.purpose: Signs demo visitor sessions; replaces DEMO_SESSION_SECRET.

entries.name: identity-session
entries.purpose: Signs demo identity sessions; replaces IDENTITY_SESSION_SECRET.

entries.name: identity-audit
entries.purpose: Keys the demo identity audit HMAC; replaces IDENTITY_AUDIT_HMAC_SECRET.

entries.name: CLOUDFLARE_BILLING_TOKEN
entries.purpose: Reads account analytics and billable usage for the demo operations report.

entries.name: DEMO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.purpose: Verifies signed calls to the demo webhook lab.

entries.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
entries.purpose: Signs GitHub App tokens for the demo reads and reporting writes; replaces three personal tokens.

entries.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.purpose: Completes GitHub sign-in on the demo.

entries.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.purpose: Verifies GitHub webhook deliveries to the demo.

entries.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.purpose: Completes Google sign-in on the demo.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.purpose: Completes Microsoft Entra sign-in on the demo.

entries.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
entries.purpose: Identifies the GitHub App the demo signs tokens for.

entries.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
entries.purpose: Public GitHub OAuth client for demo sign-in.

entries.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
entries.purpose: Public Google OAuth client for demo sign-in.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
entries.purpose: Public Microsoft Entra client for demo sign-in.

entries.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
entries.purpose: Public Microsoft Entra tenant for demo sign-in.

entries.name: SAML_IDP_CERT
entries.purpose: Public signing certificate of the SAML IdP (default: an Entra enterprise application).

entries.name: SAML_IDP_ISSUER
entries.purpose: Public entity ID of the SAML IdP.

entries.name: SAML_SSO_URL
entries.purpose: Public single sign-on URL of the SAML IdP.

entries.name: wg-cloudflare-audit
entries.purpose: Read-only audit token for the owner-run live Cloudflare comparison on the Mac.

exceptions.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
exceptions.reason: The demo deploy still runs its own demo-blob D1 migrations, which need D1 Edit.
exceptions.until: The demo Phase 4 move to records/events ends its own D1 migrations; then wg-cloudflare-demo is revoked and the demo takes wg-cloudflare-deploy.
